rights_note: A secondary web reproduction with no rights statement (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only forms, counts, places and proportions are read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset (no texture, no traced mesh), and the copy committed for the image gate (T-3188) is the store's, unaltered, with its attribution in the folder's README.
access_notes: Read 2026-10-27 (T-3188) from the image store's reference copy, 1955 x 1200 px greyscale.
note: A photograph of the Glessner townhouses, 1700-1706 Prairie, from the east side of Prairie Avenue south-east of them. 1708 Prairie stands at its left edge: the north end of its brick street front, a window in each of the upper two storeys under a hood (sills about 5.8 and 9.4 m over grade through T-3188's camera), and below them, at the north end, a moulded hood about 4.25-4.65 m over grade over the entrance, a drop under its north end. It is evidence of the street front after 1902.
what_it_supplies: the north end of 1708's street front in the plane of the townhouses' front
the upper storeys' sill heights at the north end, a cross-check on the Christmas print
the entrance hood at the north end and its height
what_it_does_not_supply: the rest of 1708's front, its cornice and its bay, all outside the frame
the south wall, the rear and the roof
